about_the_game: Unleash new depths of darkness and artistry in Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2 - Shadows & Silk. Embrace the shadows as a Lasombra, commanding the very essence of darkness to bend to your will. Or, revel in beauty and passion as a Toreador, channeling your artistic spirit to captivate and influence those around you. This Shadows & Silk unlocks two distinct and powerful vampire clans, each with unique abilities and playstyles, as well as a total of eight new outfits, offering a new way to experience Bloodlines 2.

content_descriptors.notes: This title may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work, like frequent violence or gore.
